name: Colony Plaza Ripon
summary: Colony Plaza Ripon is a community-focused neighborhood shopping center serving as Ripon's convenient one-stop shop for everyday needs. The plaza features essential services like The UPS Store, popular retailers, and hosts seasonal community events throughout the year.
demographics: Colony Plaza Ripon serves the local Ripon community and surrounding San Joaquin County area, attracting primarily middle-income families and working professionals. The trade area consists of suburban households with a mix of young families and established residents seeking convenient, everyday shopping options. Visitors typically engage in routine shopping trips for groceries, services, and quick-service dining, with strong community ties reflected in the center's local events and seasonal activities.
description: Colony Plaza Ripon proudly serves as Ripon's one-stop shop, offering a convenient collection of essential retailers and services for the local community. Located at 1290 West Colony Road in the heart of Ripon, California, this neighborhood shopping center has become an integral part of the community fabric. The plaza features a diverse mix of tenants including The UPS Store for shipping and business services, Dutch Bros coffee, and various other retailers that cater to everyday needs. Throughout the year, Colony Plaza hosts community-focused events including spring vendor markets and partners with Phantom Fireworks during the 4th of July season to provide seasonal fireworks for Ripon residents. The center's commitment to community engagement and convenient retail offerings has made it a beloved destination where locals can accomplish multiple errands in one location while supporting their neighborhood businesses.
